newsitem.title: CHINA: China aluminium smelter seen to increase output.
newsitem.headline: China aluminium smelter seen to increase output.

text.p: China's Baotou aluminium smelter in the northern region of Inner Mongolia aimed to produce 84,500 tonnes of aluminium ingots in 1997, a company official said on Monday.
Old equipment was being overhauled to boost production capacity, the official said by telephone.
Whether the target could be reached hinged on power supply, aluminium prices, demand and raw materials, he said.
Even if the target could not be met, output was expected to exceed last year's 75,000 tonnes, the official said.
Expansion of the smelter was due to be completed by July and would boost production capacity by 30,000 tonnes per annum, the official said.
Production next year was estimated at between 100,000 and 110,000 tonnes, he said.
The smelter aimed to increase its exports, which were currently only a few thousand tonnes each year, he said.
